reviewer.name: Codex independent architecture reviewer
reviewer.role: Architecture, security, accessibility, and evidence reviewer

findings.summary: M0 and release-candidate evidence is bound to revisions and product hashes older than the reviewed HEAD.
Mutation-bearing enable, reboot, after-reboot, and exact rollback evidence is absent.
Architecture allowlist and license inventory resolution were stale after new host crates and the current GPUI pin.
findings.resolution: Added both host crates and their exact dependency boundaries, generated a current 520-package inventory, corrected archived/current inventory resolution, limited source scanning to production src trees, and passed positive plus all negative fixtures.

findings.summary: Current M0 evidence asserts model accessibility, IME, and bidi outcomes without complete live UIA and input traces.
findings.owner: Desktop/taskbar accessibility and localization gate owner

findings.summary: Several security dispositions are hard-coded instead of being derived from attributable negative-test artifacts.
No Explorer-absent lifecycle proof is bound to the current candidate.
findings.owner: Shell lifecycle and owned-provider gate owner

external_release_blockers.reason: Only one active physical display is attached; virtual topology cannot substitute for the two-display physical gate.
